description: This Java source file defines the PojoProcessor class, which is responsible for processing POJO definitions, building dependencies among them, analyzing their usage within events and IPC messages, and preparing them for code generation support within a larger code generation framework.

classes.name: PojoProcessor
classes.description: A helper class responsible for managing and analyzing POJO (Plain Old Java Object) definitions within the code generation process. It builds POJO models from XML specifications, analyzes dependencies and usage, and prepares POJOs for code generation in different languages.

methods.name: buildModel
methods.description: Creates and initializes a PojoProcessor instance by parsing the ICService object for POJO definitions, building PojoWrapper objects for each POJO, and indexing them for further processing.

methods.name: analyze
methods.description: Analyzes the ICService data structure to determine POJO dependencies and language usage based on event and IPC message references.

methods.name: analyzeAgain
methods.description: Performs a second-pass analysis to identify POJOs that are defined but not used by any events or IPC messages, issuing warnings accordingly.

methods.name: getWrappers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all PojoWrapper objects managed by this processor, typically for code generation purposes.

methods.name: getPojoForName
methods.description: Retrieves a PojoWrapper instance by its variable name.
